subtasks.title: Rename duplicate startTrigger in trigger_test.go
subtasks.description:
Rename `startTrigger` in trigger_test.go to `startInboxTrigger` to resolve the go vet redeclaration error. The function in event_delivery_test.go (used by 10 call sites across event_delivery_test.go and trigger_integration_test.go) keeps its name. The function in trigger_test.go (used by 6 call sites, all within trigger_test.go) is renamed to `startInboxTrigger` since it specifically starts an InboxSignalTrigger.

This is a structural rename within a single test file — no behavior change, no API change. The existing tests ARE the verification: if the rename breaks anything, tests fail. Writing new tests for a rename would be circular.

Acceptance criteria addressed:
- go vet passes on internal/watcher/ package
- All existing tests still pass
- gofmt compliant

Module boundaries: not applicable — this is a test-only rename in an existing package with no new modules, no new exports, and no behavior change. The watcher package interface is unchanged.

module_boundaries.description: File-system and event-bus trigger implementations for agent lifecycle signals

Run `go vet ./internal/watcher/` and `go test ./internal/watcher/` to verify the rename resolved the redeclaration error, all tests pass, and gofmt is clean. No integration wiring needed — this is a single-file rename fix. The integration subtask exists solely to confirm end-to-end acceptance criteria:

- All tests pass
- gofmt compliant

tdd_exceptions.justification: Structural rename of a test helper function within a single test file — no behavior or API change. The existing 7 tests in trigger_test.go verify correctness; writing a test-for-a-rename would be circular. This is the valid 'structural refactoring with no behavior change' exception.

coverage.criterion: go vet passes on internal/watcher/ package

assumptions.decision: Rename the trigger_test.go version (startTrigger -> startInboxTrigger) rather than the event_delivery_test.go version
alternatives: Rename the event_delivery_test.go version instead (e.g., startEventDeliveryTrigger)
Rename both functions to more specific names
assumptions.why_chosen: The event_delivery_test.go version has 10 call sites across 2 files (event_delivery_test.go + trigger_integration_test.go), while trigger_test.go has only 6 call sites all within the same file. Renaming trigger_test.go's version minimizes the diff and risk. Additionally, 'startInboxTrigger' is more descriptive since it specifically creates and starts an InboxSignalTrigger.
